questions.q: What daily practice does Comer say is needed for peace?
questions.why: He states peace comes from daily silence and solitude.

questions.q: Which biblical figure is cited as modeling quiet time?
questions.why: Jesus had reverence for quiet alone time.

questions.q: What weekly habit does the book recommend even for non‑religious people?
questions.why: It suggests setting aside one day each week for rest.

questions.q: How does the author view inefficiency?
a: As a chance to be mindful
questions.why: Inefficiency can help slow down and become more mindful.

questions.q: What modern device contributes to loss of solitude, according to the text?
questions.why: Smartphones keep us connected to constant thoughts and opinions.
